title: Think Fast, Chucklenuts
blurb: The warning arrives at the same moment as the projectile, which is technically a warning and legally something else entirely. This ambush line spread through Team Fortress 2 clips and meme edits until it became the internet's standard way of announcing incoming chaos to somebody with no time left to act on the information. Play it before tossing anything at anybody — keys, a drink, a compliment, an unwanted responsibility. Chucklenuts is the word doing the heavy lifting. Without it you have a warning; with it you have a genre.
origin: A viral ambush line popularized through TF2 and meme edits.
